title: "Analyzing Americans' Time Use"
author: "Carly Jones"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = "data/atus.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)

dbplyr_act <- tbl(con, "activities")
dbplyr_resp <- tbl(con, "respondents")
dbplyr_codes <- tbl(con, "activity_codes")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
activity_avg <- dbplyr_resp |>
  filter(day_type == "Weekday", employment_status == "Not in labor force") |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_act, by = "tucaseid") |>
  inner_join(
    dbplyr_codes |> select(activity_code, major_name),
    by = "activity_code"
  ) |>
  group_by(sex, tucaseid, major_name) |>
  summarise(minutes = sum(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  group_by(sex, major_name) |>
  summarise(mean_weekday_minutes = mean(minutes, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
activity_avg |>
  filter(major_name != "Data Codes") |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = fct_reorder(major_name, mean_weekday_minutes, .fun = mean),
    y = mean_weekday_minutes,
    fill = sex
  )) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Weekday Minutes by Activity",
    subtitle = "Respondents not in the labor force, by sex",
    x = "Major activity category",
    y = "Average minutes per day",
    fill = "Sex",
    caption = "Source: American Time Use Survey (ATUS)"
  )
```

```{r}
major_categories <- c(
  "Eating and Drinking",
  "Personal Care Activities",
  "Socializing, Relaxing, and Leisure",
  "Household Activities"
)

respondent_counts <- dbplyr_resp |>
  filter(day_type == "Weekday", employment_status == "Not in labor force") |>
  distinct(tucaseid, sex) |>
  count(sex, name = "n_respondents") |>
  collect()

hourly_totals <- dbplyr_resp |>
  filter(day_type == "Weekday", employment_status == "Not in labor force") |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_act, by = "tucaseid") |>
  inner_join(
    dbplyr_codes |> select(activity_code, major_name),
    by = "activity_code"
  ) |>
  filter(
    major_name %in% major_categories,
    start_hhmm >= 600,
    start_hhmm < 2400
  ) |>
  mutate(hour = floor(start_hhmm / 100)) |>
  group_by(sex, major_name, hour) |>
  summarise(total_minutes = sum(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  collect()

hourly_avg <- crossing(
  sex = respondent_counts$sex,
  major_name = major_categories,
  hour = 6:23
) |>
  left_join(hourly_totals, by = c("sex", "major_name", "hour")) |>
  left_join(respondent_counts, by = "sex") |>
  mutate(
    mean_minutes = coalesce(total_minutes, 0) / n_respondents
  ) |>
  select(sex, major_name, hour, mean_minutes) |>
  arrange(sex, major_name, hour)

print(hourly_avg)
```
